people.name: Ahimaaz
people.line: Son of Zadok the priest, a messenger for David

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: En-rogel
people.line: Spring near Jerusalem; associated with Adonijah's and David's kingships

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Son of Abiathar the priest during David's reign

translations.web: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and tell them; and they went and told king David. For they might not be seen to come into the city.
translations.bsb: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En-rogel, where a servant girl would come and pass along information to them. They in turn would go and inform King David, for they dared not be seen entering the city.
translations.kjv: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.
translations.asv: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En-rogel; and a maid-servant used to go and tell them; and they went and told king David: for they might not be seen to come into the city.
